channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PF deve encerrar inquérito do Master em um mês
item.description: The Federal Police is expected to conclude its investigation into banking fraud at Banco Master by the end of August, with Daniel Vorcaro almost certain to be indicted and politicians like Jaques Wagner set to testify on August 7. Concurrently, 2026 election preparations are underway as parties finalize candidacies and the PF investigates alleged use of parliamentary amendments for political influence. Polls show two-thirds of Flávio Bolsonaro’s voters may switch to defeat Lula, with Ronaldo Caiado seen as a useful vote and Lula in a technical tie with Flávio and Caiado in a potential runoff.

item.title: Crusoé: Biden brasileiro tem medo de debate
item.description: Lula's campaign is considering avoiding debates and sabatinas before the 2026 first round to protect his image, amid criticism from Flávio Bolsonaro, a PL pré-candidate, who dubbed him the 'Brazilian Biden'. The move aims to mitigate reputational risks ahead of the election.

item.title: Presidente do MDB responde ao STF e nega participação na indicação de emendas
item.description: The national president of the MDB, federal deputy Baleia Rossi (SP), sent responses to Justice Flávio Dino of the STF denying that the party’s presidency participates in the indication of parliamentary amendments. He emphasized that amendment decisions are the individual prerogative of each legislator. The statement was made in response to the minister’s inquiries about potential irregularities in resource allocation.

item.title: Dívidas com agências reguladoras disparam, e balcão único de negociação fracassa
item.description: Debts owed by individuals and companies to regulatory agencies surged in 2026, while the Lula government's plan to create a single negotiation desk to speed up payments and boost revenue failed. The main reason for the failure was the lack of consensus among stakeholders on establishing a new agency responsible for collection, which prevented the implementation of the proposed model.

item.title: Como se nada estivesse a acontecer
item.description: The article criticizes the absence of ecological crisis debate in Brazil's 2026 elections, despite escalating environmental devastation and global climate impacts. Hegemonic left sectors remain trapped in developmentalist nostalgia, while fear of Bolsonaro's return dominates the agenda, ignoring urgent issues like floods, wildfires, and climate migration. The author warns that Brazil is choosing between submission to U.S. imperialism and neglect of its own ecological survival.

item.title: André do Prado posta foto ao lado de Tarcísio, Flávio e Derrite
item.description: André do Prado (PL), president of the Alesp, posted a photo alongside Tarcísio de Freitas, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Guilherme Derrite, reinforcing their alliance for the 2026 Senate race, with Prado taking the slot originally meant for Eduardo Bolsonaro, who remains first alternate despite his STF conviction.

item.title: Meio-Dia em Brasília: Eduardo Bolsonaro é norte-americano; Caiado desafia Lula
item.description: A new electoral poll shows Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) numerically ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in a potential 2026 runoff. The program also notes Eduardo Bolsonaro holds U.S. citizenship, raising eligibility concerns, and highlights the PT's apprehension about upcoming debates and candidate interrogations.

item.title: Governo Lula minimiza alianças restritas à esquerda e celebra Centrão neutro
item.description: Lula's allies downplay the fact that his presidential alliances are limited to left-wing parties, emphasizing that many members of the Centrão are expected to openly support his re-election. They view the likely neutrality of center-party blocs as a greater victory for Lula than for Flávio Bolsonaro, who struggles to build a coalition without notable progress. The Centrão’s neutrality is seen as strategically advantageous for the Workers’ Party campaign.

item.title: A 4 dias de convenção, Flávio Bolsonaro não tem vice nem partidos na chapa
item.description: Four days before the PL's national convention, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has yet to define a vice-presidential running mate or solidify party alliances for the presidential race. Resistance from Centrão parties, particularly the União Brasil-PP federation—which is expected to declare neutrality—and the Republicans, which favors not supporting national candidates, hinders coalition-building. The uncertainty reduces Bolsonaro’s projected radio and TV ad time to about four minutes per block, compared to Lula’s slightly over five minutes.

item.title: Tarifaço: setor de máquinas diz não apoiar reciprocidade e defende ampliação de programa de crédito para empresas afetadas
item.description: The Brazilian Machinery and Equipment Industry Association (Abimaq) opposed the proposed tariff reciprocity by the Lula government in response to U.S. tariffs, advocating for diplomatic and business channels instead. The group urged expansion of the Brazil Soberano credit program to support affected firms, alongside strengthening international negotiations and diversifying markets. Abimaq President José Velloso noted that despite U.S. trade barriers, the sector’s exports rose 12% over the past year, reaching a record high.

item.title: Crusoé: Renan Santos alcança a barreira dos 10%
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party, reached 9% in voting intentions in the Realtime Big Data poll released on April 21, marking his best performance so far and placing him third. Lula leads with 40%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro in second. The poll was published by Crusoé and referenced by O Antagonista.

item.title: Trump adota estratégia para reconstruir muro tarifário global. Entenda como
item.description: President Donald Trump is preparing a new round of tariffs on imports from dozens of countries, with a possible announcement this week, following the expiration of the current 10% global tariff on Friday. The strategy involves sector-specific tariffs based on forced labor investigations to bypass Supreme Court restrictions that struck down reciprocal tariffs earlier this year. Despite warnings from his economic team about the risks of escalating trade tensions ahead of the November midterm legislative elections, Trump has already raised tariffs on Canadian (50%) and Brazilian (25%) goods as a tool of commercial pressure.

item.title: Brasil tem quase 2 milhões de eleitores com deficiência, aponta TSE
item.description: Brazil has nearly 2 million voters with disabilities eligible to vote in the 2026 elections, a 42.5% increase from 2022. The Electoral Justice has expanded accessibility, growing from 156,296 to 223,587 adapted polling stations. The deadline to request transfer to accessible voting sections is August 20.

item.title: Decreto autoriza atuação das Forças Armadas nas eleições de 2026
item.description: The Presidency of the Republic issued a decree authorizing the use of the Armed Forces in the 2026 Elections, with operations planned during voting, vote counting, and logistical support, upon request of the TSE. The measure is based on the Federal Constitution, Complementary Law No. 97/1999, and the Electoral Code, and follows past practices where the Armed Forces were deployed to strengthen security and logistics in strategic or hard-to-reach areas.

item.title: Governo brasileiro vê Green Card para Eduardo Bolsonaro como gesto político de gestão Trump
item.description: Brazilian government officials view the U.S. granting of a Green Card to Eduardo Bolsonaro as a political gesture by the Donald Trump administration aimed at strengthening the Bolsonaro clan in the 2026 election race against Lula. The interpretation is that Trump is using immigration favors to benefit the Bolsonaro family, particularly to support a potential candidacy by Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Partido Missão oficializa Renan Santos como candidato à Presidência
item.description: The Mission Party officially nominated Renan Santos as its presidential candidate during an anticipated national convention on Monday (20), while planning an August 1 event to unveil its government program. Founded in November 2025 and rooted in the Free Brazil Movement (MBL), which gained prominence during the 2015 impeachment campaign against Dilma Roussef, the party is contesting its first election. On the same day, the PDT announced its support for Lula's re-election bid.

item.title: Governo faz 1ª rodada de reuniões com setores afetados pelo tarifaço
item.description: The federal government began meetings with sectors affected by the new 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian products, starting with Vice President Geraldo Alckmin’s meeting with Abimaq and, in the afternoon, President Lula’s meeting with the Finance and Industry Ministers. The government is preparing a support program, including expanding the Brazil Sovereign Plan and investing R$130 million in market diversification, to mitigate the $7.2 billion impact on Brazilian exports to the U.S.

item.title: Indexa: Flávio Bolsonaro tem rejeição de 50% e Lula de 49%; estão empatados tecnicamente
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads in rejection among 2026 presidential pre-candidates, with 50% of voters saying they would never vote for him, according to an Indexa poll released exclusively by Broadcast Político. Lula has 49% rejection, technically tied with Bolsonaro, while 31% of respondents say they would certainly vote for the senator and 13% say they might vote for him.

item.title: Lula lidera disputa contra Flávio Bolsonaro, aponta Indexa Pesquisas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leads the presidential race against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, having widened his lead over the past two months, according to an Indexa poll released Tuesday (21).

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro ataca direita do Ceará por apoio a Ciro: "Vendida"
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro criticized the Ceará right-wing for supporting pre-candidate Ciro Gomes (PSDB), who did not mention Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) as a potential presidential ally. She argued that the state PL's backing of Ciro is politically incoherent and accused the local right of being 'sold out,' instead advocating for support of Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo).

item.title: Os próximos passos do governo Lula para conter danos pelo novo tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government is mobilizing to mitigate the damage from the new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, holding meetings between Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, Minister Márcio Elias Rosa, and affected sectors like textiles and footwear to design a relief package. The strategy avoids using the reciprocity law due to electoral concerns and instead seeks targeted exceptions through direct negotiations, with the expectation that the U.S. will only revisit the issue after its own elections.

item.title: Governo Lula é desaprovado por 50% e aprovado por 46%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll shows 50% of respondents disapprove of President Lula's government, while 46% approve. The evaluation indicates 35% rate the administration as 'excellent/good', 26% as 'fair', and 38% as 'poor/terrible'. The study, registered with the TSE under BR-05864/2026, surveyed 2,000 people from July 18-20, 2026, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Aliado diz que Eduardo obteve Green Card por “habilidades extraordinárias”
item.description: A Bolsonaro-allied journalist Paulo Figueiredo claimed Eduardo Bolsonaro obtained a U.S. Green Card under the 'extraordinary abilities' category, one month after his STF conviction for pressuring judges and attempting to undermine the coup plot trial. Eduardo has been abroad since February 2025, with his mandate revoked and 8 years of ineligibility, but allies speculate he may return to run for Senate in 2026.

item.title: TSE divulga limites de gastos de campanha para as Eleições Gerais de 2026
item.description: The TSE released the campaign spending limits for the 2026 General Elections, maintaining the same values applied in 2022, based on the Special Campaign Financing Fund (FEFC) of R$4.9 billion. The unanimous decision by the TSE Plenary aims to ensure financial balance among parties and preserve inclusion policies, as no legislative changes or FEFC adjustments occurred. The TSE also published the number of eligible voters per municipality, used to calculate the spending limits.

item.title: Zanatta cita tarifaço ao embasar pedido de impeachment de Lula
item.description: Deputy Júlia Zanatta (PL-SC) is gathering signatures for an impeachment request against President Lula, aiming to file it in the Chamber of Deputies in August. The move relies on comments by U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio alleging Lula negotiated in bad faith with the Trump administration on trade tariffs, allegedly exposing Brazil to disproportionate economic risks. Zanatta claims Lula acted for personal, ideological, or electoral motives and demands ministers involved be summoned and unanswered information requests addressed; so far, 21 lawmakers have signed the petition.

item.title: “Mais uma tentativa absurda e ilegal de intimidação”, diz Vieira sobre PGR
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) criticized the submission of a representation by Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes against him to the Electoral Prosecutor's Office, calling it 'another absurd and illegal attempt at intimidation'. He said he learned of the action through the press.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Lula tem vantagem em relação a Flávio na reta final de definição de palanques estaduais
item.description: Lula holds an advantage over Flávio Bolsonaro in the final stages of defining state-level alliances for the 2026 elections, with a broader and more organized regional support network stemming from a pragmatic strategy of sacrificing local candidacies. Flávio Bolsonaro has yet to name a running mate and struggles to build a broad coalition, which could result in 20% fewer TV ad slots if he remains solely allied with the PL. The Electoral Justice is already playing a central role, as the PL filed an action at the TSE seeking to expose an alleged negative content-boosting network against Flávio.

item.title: Em convenção nacional, PDT oficializa apoio a Lula nas eleições
item.description: The PDT officially endorsed President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election bid at a national convention held in Brasília on Monday (20). Party leader Carlos Lupi justified the alliance as part of the fight against the far-right. Lula attended the event and addressed attendees, though he remains an official pre-candidate, with the PT's national convention scheduled for August 2.

item.title: Lula faz convite irônico a Marco Rubio: ‘Que venha’
item.description: President Lula responded ironically to U.S. tariff threats, inviting Marco Rubio to support Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 elections, asserting Brazil will defeat any foreign interference in defense of democracy. He also criticized 'traitors of the homeland' without naming them, echoing past accusations against the Bolsonaro family. Tensions escalated after the U.S. announced 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, claiming Brazil negotiated in bad faith.

item.title: Lula autoriza Forças Armadas a atuar nas eleições de 2026
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva authorized the deployment of the Armed Forces in the 2026 elections to ensure voting, vote counting, and logistical support, as stated in Decree No. 13.073 published in the Official Gazette on July 21, 2026. Operations will be defined according to TSE requests, grounded in the Electoral Code and Complementary Law No. 97/1999. The measure took effect upon publication.

item.title: EUA podem perder para o Brasil o papel de maior exportador agrícola do mundo, diz Financial Times
item.description: The United States risks losing its position as the world's top agricultural exporter to Brazil, according to the Financial Times. Brazilian agricultural exports grew 6% in the first half of 2026, reaching $87 billion, narrowing the gap with the U.S. from $56 billion in 2021 to just $2 billion. This shift is driven by Trump-era tariffs on China, which redirected Chinese soybean purchases from the U.S. to Brazil, making Brazil China’s top soybean supplier.

item.title: Ao lado de Lupi, Lula ignora fraudes no INSS e exalta apoio do PDT à reeleição
item.description: President Lula met with former Minister Carlos Lupi (PDT) and allies to celebrate the party's support for his 2026 re-election bid, ignoring the INSS fraud scandal that occurred under Lupi's leadership, which stole over R$6.3 billion from more than 5 million retirees. Lula praised Lupi, highlighted the PDT's legacy, and criticized current politics for lacking 'decency' and 'respect', indirectly referencing the Bolsonaro administration. Despite corruption allegations involving Lupi were not addressed, as Lula focused on lead to criminal investigations of Lupi's associates, Lula emphasized political alliance and invoked the symbols of Brizola and Vargas.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 49% e aprovado por 46% no RJ
item.description: In Rio de Janeiro, 49% of voters disapprove of Lula's government, while 46% approve it, according to a Gerp poll conducted from July 13–15, 2026. The margin of error is 3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level. Among evaluations, 34% rated the government as 'terrible', 21% as 'regular', and 16% as 'excellent'.

item.title: Lula torce pela saúde política de Flávio para liquidar no 1° turno
item.description: Lula aims to win the 2026 election in the first round — an unprecedented feat in his political career — but avoids publicizing it to prevent complacency among his base. His strategy relies on keeping Flávio Bolsonaro as a weak but viable opponent who can monopolize the right-wing field and block stronger contenders. The Planalto fears Flávio’s candidacy could collapse too quickly, opening space for a more dangerous right-wing alternative.

item.title: Lula completou cinco meses estagnado no patamar de 40% das pesquisas
item.description: Lula has been stagnant at 40% in voting intention polls for five months, unable to advance despite improved approval of his government. Flávio Bolsonaro of the PL is his main rival, and together they capture 70% of the votes from decided voters, who make up only 46% of the electorate. With 54% of voters still undecided and other candidates largely unknown, the election remains open and undefined.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula têm empate técnico no 2º turno no RJ
item.description: A Gerp poll released on July 21, 2026 shows a technical tie in the Rio de Janeiro runoff between President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (44%) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (45%), with a margin of error of 3.1 percentage points. In the first round, Lula has 38% and Flávio 37%, while Lula’s rejection stands at 47% and Flávio’s at 45%. Government approval for Lula is 46% with 49% disapproval in the state.

item.title: Caiado aparece numericamente à frente de Lula no 2º turno, indica Realtime
item.description: Realtime Big Data poll shows Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) leading Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) 44% to 43% in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff, with 8% blank/null votes and 5% undecided. Caiado’s narrow lead falls within the margin of error, indicating a technical tie. The survey was released on Tuesday, the 21st.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas serão divulgadas nesta 3ª feira
item.description: Various polling institutes are authorized by the TSE to release electoral surveys starting Tuesday, July 21, 2026, with data collected between July 7 and 20. The surveys cover national voting intentions (Real Time Big Data and Indexa) and state-level scenarios in 12 federal units, including Amapá, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Maranhão, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Norte (two polls) and Sergipe. All studies were registered with the Electoral Justice and may only be published after the minimum legal period has elapsed.

item.title: Flávio oscila para cima e volta a empatar com Lula em segundo turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: The Real Time Big Data poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro gained two points in the second-round scenario, reaching 42% against Lula's 45%, resulting in a technical tie within the margin of error. In the first-round scenario, Lula holds 40% and Flávio 33%, maintaining a seven-point lead. The survey interviewed 2,000 people nationwide from July 18–20, with a 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Incêndios na Amazônia caíram a mínimo histórico em 2025
item.description: In 2025, Amazon wildfires fell to their lowest level since records began in 1985, with only 3.1 million hectares burned — a sharp decline from 15.8 million hectares in 2024, according to MapBiomas. The drop, attributed to delayed rains, reduced deforestation, and heightened community awareness following 2024’s devastating fires, was praised as a policy success for President Lula’s re-election bid in October 2026. However, fire levels in the Cerrado remained comparable to the previous year.

item.title: Com prazo curto, Flávio Bolsonaro corre contra o tempo para encontrar vice com potencial
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL’s pre-candidate for president, is racing against time to find a female running mate after a public rift with Michelle Bolsonaro. He has approached Senator Tereza Cristina (PP), deputies Simone Marquetto and Clarissa Tércio, and economist Daniella Marques (Republicanos), but none have accepted, with allies acknowledging some candidates lack competitiveness. Both PP and Republicanos insist on neutrality, prioritizing congressional strength over presidential alignment.

item.title: Nordeste ganhou 1,1 milhão de eleitores em 4 anos; Sudeste perdeu
item.description: The Northeast gained 1.14 million voters between 2022 and 2026, reaching 43.53 million, while the Southeast lost 378,090 voters, driven by a decline in São Paulo. Despite the loss, the Southeast remains the largest electoral college with 66.33 million voters. The Northeast's growth benefits Lula (PT), a region historically favorable to the left, while the Southeast's decline hinders Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign, given his poor performance there in 2022.

item.title: Jogos de hoje, terça, 21 de julho: onde assistir futebol ao vivo e horários
item.description: On Tuesday, July 21, 2026, there are key matches in the Brasileirão Série A and B, along with Copa Sudamericana playoffs and the Supercopa Argentina. Highlights include Atlético Mineiro vs Bahia at 7:30 PM (Sportv and Premiere) and Universidad Central vs Santos at 9:30 PM (SBT, ESPN and Disney+), a decisive match for Santos' continuation in the continental tournament.

item.title: Governo deve se reunir com setores afetados por tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The Brazilian government will meet with representatives from sectors most affected by the new 25% U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports, effective July 22, which are expected to impact 18% of Brazil’s exports to the U.S. (US$7.4 billion in 2024). Discussions, led by the MDIC and Finance Ministry, include expanding the Brazil Sovereign Plan, financial aid, and market diversification, with exceptions for coffee, beef, fish, rare earths, and orange. Vice President Alckmin confirmed a support program for impacted sectors, mirroring the response to Trump’s 2025 tariff increase.

item.title: A reunião entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Marcos Pereira para tentar a aliança na disputa pela Presidência
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro of the PL and Marcos Pereira of the Republicans met on Thursday night with Rogério Marinho to attempt to form an alliance for the 2026 presidential race. The meeting was held in the evening and reported as exclusive content for subscribers, with no specific terms of the negotiation disclosed.

item.title: Kalil é eleito "novo Ciro Gomes" por ala do PDT
item.description: A faction of the PDT has begun referring to Alexandre Kalil, the pre-candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, as the 'new Ciro Gomes' due to his criticisms of President Lula and the PT, echoing Ciro Gomes' stance within the party. The nickname emerged after Kalil skipped the PDT's national convention in Brasília, where Lula was present, causing discontent among party leaders.

item.title: Bancada do Master sofre baixas nas eleições e tenta sobreviver em pré-campanha
item.description: The Banco Master scandal led to the withdrawal of Cláudio Castro (PL) and Ibaneis Rocha (MDB) from Senate candidacies following investigations and political fallout tied to banker Daniel Vorcaro. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) also saw his polling drop after audio emerged showing he requested money from Vorcaro to fund a film about his father, ex-president Jair Bolsonaro. The so-called 'Bancada do Master' is attempting to survive in the pre-campaign phase amid mounting scrutiny over its ties to the businessman.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio cogitam apoiar Garotinho ao governo do RJ após novo revés em chapa do PL
item.description: Leaders of Rio de Janeiro's PL party are considering supporting Anthony Garotinho (Republicanos) for governor after Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket lost its running mate, Douglas Ruas, following Rogério Lisboa's withdrawal. Garotinho has officially launched his candidacy with Marcelo Crivella as his Senate pre-candidate, while the PL evaluates replacing Márcio Canella with Crivella due to Canella's arrest for illegal firearm possession. A potential PL-Republicans alliance aims to strengthen the right-wing position in the state.

item.title: Qual é a data das eleições de 2026 para presidente, governador, senador e deputado?
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections will take place in two rounds: the first round on October 4 for president, governor, senator, and deputies; the second round, if needed, on October 25. Electoral campaigning begins on August 16, and the deadline to regularize voter registration is May 6, 2026.

item.title: Charge do Aroeira
item.description: The Aroeira cartoon, published on Blog do Noblat, reflects the current Brazilian political landscape: Lula is smiling in the polls while the opposition is struggling, symbolized by 'bleeding'. The post also mentions state-level conventions solidifying candidacies and alliances, along with articles on diverse topics such as sports and international politics.
